title: Peace & Rest
intro: Sleep is the whole subject of the first year, and it is never only about sleep. This month asks for rest for a baby who is learning it and for parents who have forgotten it, and it says the thing worth saying at 4am: that peace here is given rather than achieved.

keyScriptures.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.
Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

weeks.title: Rest Is Given, Not Earned
weeks.declaration: Rest is not a reward for a day gone well. It was made before anyone had achieved anything.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give rest in this house tonight. We cannot manufacture it. Amen.

weeks.title: Safe Enough to Sleep
weeks.declaration: You can sleep because you are safe, not because everything is finished. Nothing is finished, and you can sleep anyway.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Lord, let this child feel safe enough to sleep. Let us feel safe enough to let them. Amen.

weeks.title: Quiet Is Not Empty
weeks.declaration: There will be quiet in this house on purpose, and it will not be wasted time. Some of the best of God is only heard in it.
weeks.parentsPrayer: God, teach us to be still even now. Let our child grow up unafraid of quiet. Amen.

weeks.title: Peace That Is Not Circumstantial
weeks.declaration: The peace here does not depend on the night going well. It is steadier than that.
weeks.parentsPrayer: Father, give us a peace that holds when nothing is resolved. Amen.

days.title: Rest Is Given
days.declaration: Rest was made before anyone had achieved anything. It is not a reward.

scripture.text: On the seventh day he rested from all his work.

days.title: Safe Enough to Sleep
days.declaration: You can sleep because you are safe, not because the day is finished.

scripture.text: In peace I will lie down and sleep.

days.title: You Are Not Holding the Night
days.declaration: You can sleep as deeply as you like. Holding the night together was never your job.

scripture.text: He will neither slumber nor sleep.

days.title: Sleep Is a Gift
days.declaration: Sleep is something given, not something achieved. May it be given generously here.

scripture.text: He grants sleep to those he loves.

days.title: Come and Rest
days.declaration: When you are worn out, there is somewhere to go. That offer never closes.

scripture.text: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened.

days.title: Quiet Waters
days.declaration: God is not always speeding anyone up. Sometimes He leads to still water.

scripture.text: He leads me beside quiet waters.

days.title: Peace Not Circumstantial
days.declaration: The peace here does not depend on how the night goes.

scripture.text: I do not give to you as the world gives.

days.title: Held While You Sleep
days.declaration: You are held while you sleep by hands that do not get tired.

scripture.text: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms.

days.title: Nothing to Prove Tonight
days.declaration: There is nothing to prove tonight, by you or by us. Nobody is being assessed.

scripture.text: It is by grace you have been saved.

days.title: Worry Is Not Watching
days.declaration: Worrying over you does not keep you safer. Praying does more and costs less.

scripture.text: Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life?

days.title: The Weight Handed Over
days.declaration: We are handing over what we cannot carry, tonight and every night.

scripture.text: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

days.title: Quiet Is Not Empty
days.declaration: Quiet is not wasted. Some of the best things happen in a room with nothing on.

scripture.text: Be still, and know that I am God.

days.title: One Day at a Time
days.declaration: Today had enough in it. Tomorrow is not ours to carry yet.

scripture.text: Tomorrow will worry about itself.

days.title: Slow Is Fine
days.declaration: Nobody is behind here. This is being done at the pace it actually takes.

scripture.text: In quietness and trust is your strength.

days.title: A Gentle Whisper
days.declaration: God rarely shouts. That is a good reason to make room for quiet.

scripture.text: And after the fire came a gentle whisper.

days.title: Rest Before Empty
days.declaration: We will try to rest before we have run out, not after. Recovery costs far more.

scripture.text: Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.

days.title: Unfinished Is Allowed
days.declaration: Things will be left undone tonight. That is a normal life, not a failure.

scripture.text: His mercies are new every morning.

days.title: Peace at Four in the Morning
days.declaration: There is a peace that stands guard over a mind at 4am. May it stand over ours.

scripture.text: The peace of God will guard your hearts and your minds.

days.title: Not in Charge of Everything
days.declaration: Some of what we fear is not ours to fix. We are handing that back tonight.

scripture.text: Cast your cares on the Lord and he will sustain you.

days.title: Held in the Small Hours
days.declaration: In the hardest hour of the night, you are held. So are we.

scripture.text: I think of you through the watches of the night.

days.title: Busy Is Not Better
days.declaration: A quiet day is not a wasted day. You will learn that from us or not at all.

scripture.text: You are worried and upset about many things.

days.title: Rhythm, Not Collapse
days.declaration: We are aiming for a rhythm rather than sprinting until something breaks.

scripture.text: Six days you shall labour... the seventh is a sabbath.

days.title: Safe to Be Tired
days.declaration: It is safe to be tired here. Nobody in this house has to perform.

scripture.text: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

days.title: Breathing Is a Prayer
days.declaration: When it is too much, a breath and one word is a real prayer. That is enough.

scripture.text: God is our refuge and strength.

days.title: Comforted in the Night
days.declaration: When you are frightened in the night, you are comforted. Always, and without exception.

scripture.text: As a mother comforts her child, so will I comfort you.

days.title: Not Rushing You
days.declaration: God is not in a hurry with you. You do not have to grow faster than you are.

scripture.text: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years.

days.title: Stillness Is Doing Something
days.declaration: Sitting still with God is not idleness. It is where a great deal gets done.

scripture.text: Truly my soul finds rest in God.

days.title: Sabbath for This House
days.declaration: There will be a day off in this house. You will grow up thinking that is normal.

scripture.text: Remember the Sabbath day by keeping it holy.

days.title: Kept in Perfect Peace
days.declaration: There is a steadiness available that does not depend on anything being fixed.

scripture.text: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast.

days.title: Enough Has Been Done
days.declaration: Enough has been done today. Whatever is left can be put down until the morning.

scripture.text: It is finished.

days.title: Rest to Carry Forward
days.declaration: The rest we are learning now is for the loud years ahead. It is a habit, not a phase.

scripture.text: He refreshes my soul.
